title: The Brush sits right after Crop on a picture's tool bar, where the mock draws it
goal: On a picture the Brush button sits near the right end of the tool bar beside the paint bucket, while the image mock (and Photoshop) put it with the first tools, right after Crop. Move it to the mock's place so a Photoshop user finds it where they look.
notes: Found by the brush epic final audit (a-brush-tool-paints-with-realistic-charcoal-chal), 2026-10-31. Mock order: Select, Lasso, Magic wand, Crop, Brush (B), Eraser, Heal, Clone stamp, Patch, Dodge/Burn, Pen, Text, Shape, Measure, Hand, Zoom. Shipped (Next defaults, 1280 pt window, 2026-10-31-brush-epic-1-watercolour-in-hand-sc.png): Select, Marquee, Crop, Measure | Arrow, Line, Highlighter, Text, Combine, Rectangle, Pen, Component | Brush | Bucket | Hand | Color. The bar adds flag tools at the end of the drawing family (slice 1 note on the umbrella, 2026-10-25). Brush is absent on a document with time (B is the Blade there), so only the picture bar changes. grep Scripts/playtest for tool bar points before moving it.
acceptance: On a picture at Next defaults, the tool bar reads Select, Marquee, Crop, then Brush, matching the order the image mock draws (docs/design/mocks/pages/image.html, tool bar)
Every walk that clicks a tool bar button by its position still lands on the tool it meant, updated in the same commit
A side by side of the shipped tool bar and the mock tool bar is in the audit

log.note: triage 2026-10-31: checked queue/audits/2026-10-31-brush-epic-1-watercolour-in-hand-sc.png at Next defaults: the bar reads Select, Marquee, Crop, Measure | Arrow, Line, Highlighter, Text, Combine, Rectangle, Pen, Component | Brush | Bucket | Hand | colour, so Brush is 13th where the mock puts it 5th. Confirmed. It is a gap below the mock, not a bug a command reproduces; kept p1 because a Photoshop user pressing for the Brush looks beside Crop first, placed after the focus work since it serves image-paint.

Review before building: a Photoshop user looks for the Brush among the first tools, and the mock (image.html tool bar) draws Select, Lasso, Wand | Crop, Brush. Moving it shifts Measure and every drawing tool one slot right; on a narrow window it now folds after the drawing tools rather than first, which suits a tool you paint dozens of strokes with. Video bars have no Brush, so nothing there moves.

Chose Brush inside the first family (Select, Marquee, Crop, Brush, Measure | drawing...) over starting a new family at Crop, because the acceptance names that order and it keeps the families the tool bar grouping task set; the mock's hairline placement and Measure's late slot are listed in the audit's rough lines.

Built: ToolBarLayout.bar puts .brush after .crop (test theBrushSitsRightAfterCrop, TDD). Walks: new brush-sits-after-crop-walk (Next defaults, no flags; pointer windowClick on the fourth slot picks the Brush, B too) and design-mode-tool-strip-walk's two bar-order claims updated.
